items.statement: The submission performs and documents a converged geometry optimization for neutral singlet M3 and validates the resulting stationary point or transparently reports a bounded failure.
items.expected: A reproducible optimization with convergence evidence, charge 0, multiplicity 1, and minimum validation (or explicitly documented bounded-failure route).

items.statement: The submission independently identifies the stacking axis and measures planarity and the chemically relevant N···S contact from the optimized geometry.
items.expected: Explicit axis convention plus reported planarity and N···S metric, with atom identity/order unambiguous.

items.statement: The calculation extracts a full quadrupole tensor and identifies the stacking-axis component for M3.
items.expected: Qxx, Qyy and stacking-axis Qzz are reported in Debye with origin and convention.

items.statement: The calculated molecular dipole is interpreted together with the quadrupole tensor.
items.expected: The report states the computed dipole magnitude and whether the result supports a predominantly quadrupolar, net-dipole-cancelled description within the chosen model.
